gotchas: Sign-in is one-time-code only, with no password field: on /account/login click text="Use Email-ID", fill input[type="email"] with the login identifier, click button:has-text("Continue"), and a six-box code step appears (input[type="number"] x6, no name/id/autocomplete). detect_challenge does not recognise it (#732), so hand it off with request_challenge_handoff reason owner_code; the code goes to the account's email. Signed in = no 'Login' link in the header. signIn is not recorded because the schema requires a password field.

Card form is inline on the payment page, no iframe: number, a single MM/YY expiry box (fill as MM/YY), and a password-type CVV box. No cardholder-name field. Fill expiry first, then number and CVV back to back.
Use 'Buy now' on the product page rather than the cart: it checks out that item alone, so items already in the account's cart are not swept into the order.
Fees are added on top of the item price (platform fee and handling fee were about 70 INR on a 50 INR item), so the total is well above the listed price.
Flipkart class names are obfuscated; there is no stable plain-CSS selector for the order total. On this run the card fill was not denied, so the vault read the total without a hint.
notes: 2026-10-22, staging proxy, India egress. Signed in with an existing account via owner-code handoff, reached payment, filled expiry, card number and CVV (owner entered the live CVV), stopped before the pay click. No order placed.

route.note: Sign in first (no guest checkout; see gotchas), then search for a cheap item and open its product page. Product links open in a new tab: switch to it.
Order summary step: 'Deliver to' shows the account's saved address; Continue goes to payment options.
Opens the inline card form under the Credit / Debit / ATM Card option.
